notes: Split to-dos/reminders from dispo planning - dispo now lives only in the Dispo tab
Removed swipe gestures; rounded/note are now big labeled buttons
Cards stay in a fixed order; tap Sort to switch between room order and progress order
Whole card taps open/close; expanded view shows to-dos, reminders, and notes together
Big start/stop timer visible without opening the card
New Reminders tab: patient cards showing just their to-do/reminder list
Dispo tab: EDD is now a dropdown that resolves to a real date and updates itself day to day
Reaching EDD = Today reveals a MOIST discharge checklist on that patient
Added PT/OT disposition recommendation + date recommended
Added a pending/awaiting-something flag with a reason field, shown on the Dispo tab
